title: Hyperelliptic exact reference API
objective: Implement the ordinary-Python genus-2/3 reference API and its checked genus-2 smalljac adapter, including exact Frobenius reconstruction, local-factor ranges, fallbacks, caching, and focused oracle tests

handoff.summary: Added the checked ordinary-Python smalljac adapter for finite odd prime-field genus-2 Frobenius polynomials and QQ single/range local factors. The adapter serializes exact integral models, validates every packed native status/row/range/coefficient contract, reconstructs and checks full reciprocal degree-4 polynomials, skips bad/excluded primes in plural APIs, retains exhaustive fallbacks, caches exact results, and agrees with the independent oracle corpus.
risks: The repository-wide architecture gate currently reports the three already-integrated smalljac native files as unclassified; this lane does not claim architecture/native-code.json or those native files.
Cross-platform native validation belongs to the smalljac boundary lane; this ordinary-Python lane was validated on linux-x64 against its packed addon contract.
next_steps: Integrate this commit after the native boundary commits and rerun the repository architecture/native and platform CI gates.
Use local_lpolynomial_chunks as the bounded source for later global L-series consumers.
